## Goal
Owners sign in with Google (openid email profile only, no Google review) and their tokens carry custom:tenant_id that users cannot edit.

## Owns
- `infra/cdk/lib/auth-stack.ts`
- `services/auth/**`

## Tests first (write them, see them fail, then implement)
- pre-token handler: MEMBER# lookup sets custom:tenant_id/role; unknown user gets no tenant claim; suspended tenant still signs in but claim state=suspended.

## Steps
- Add UserPoolIdentityProviderGoogle with secret from Secrets Manager.
- Hosted UI domain per stage; callback URLs for the owner PWA and localhost.
- Document the Google OAuth client setup (scopes, authorized redirect URIs) in services/auth/README.md.

## Acceptance
- Sign-in works in dev with a real Google account; ID token contains custom:tenant_id after onboarding.

## Run
`pnpm vitest run services/auth` and `make test` before opening the PR.
